The year '''1046 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Births==
*Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]] are born.<ref name="DromikaQuillanBirthYear">Page 181 of the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] mentions that Quillan was 14 years old during the events of the book. As the [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], this places the twins' birth in circa 1046 BBY.</ref>
